$comment: Staging manifest for the Lexicon `cloudwatch-metrics.json` registration and the Main Dashboard widgets. Every metric emitted by this service appears here. The Lexicon and Dashboard repositories live in another GitHub organisation and could not be updated from this workspace — see the Phase 0 notes in README.md.

metrics.name: RequestProcessed
metrics.description: A tRPC request served successfully by the API Lambda.

metrics.name: RequestFailed
metrics.description: A tRPC request that threw out of the Lambda handler.

metrics.name: AlertProcessed
metrics.description: A PagerDuty trigger accepted (HTTP 202) or suppressed by environment gating.

metrics.name: AlertFailed
metrics.description: A PagerDuty trigger that PagerDuty did not accept.

metrics.name: RunProcessed
metrics.description: An ingestion run recorded by the SeminoleRefresh state machine.

metrics.name: RunFailed
metrics.description: An ingestion run that failed during bookkeeping.

metrics.name: ParcelProcessed
metrics.description: A parcel dispatched to the permit-harvest queue.

metrics.name: ParcelFailed
metrics.description: A parcel that could not be dispatched.

metrics.name: PermitProcessed
metrics.description: A permit-harvest message handled by the queue worker.

metrics.name: PermitFailed
metrics.description: A permit-harvest message that failed and will be retried or redriven.

metrics.name: ProcessingDuration
metrics.description: Wall-clock duration of one unit of work.

metrics.name: CostPredicted
metrics.description: Forecast USD cost of one invocation, joinable against the project_name cost-allocation tag.
